description: Append-only change log for AP infrastructure (Bot, prompts, Notion DBs, configs). Mirrors Thor V0.1 CHG_LOG. Each entry: ts (UTC ISO), category, scope, version_from→version_to, summary, files. See AP_Sustainability_Roadmap_v0.2.md §3 Item 5.

entries.summary: Sprint 1 — Discord-native Council sign-off via ✅/❌ reactions on #council-decisions (藍圖 v1.1 §3.4 落地). Replaces CLI-only signoff with < 60-second Craig UX.
entries.rationale: 藍圖 §0.3 要求「Craig 應該 < 60 秒簽核」— CLI signoff (`python scripts/ap_council_runner.py signoff`) 永遠做不到這個目標。Reaction handler 把 Council 議事閉環成 Discord 原生流程: PM 用 /council-show post embed 到 #council-decisions → Craig ✅/❌ react → 自動 transition + dispatch tasks + edit embed.
